title: The ribosome modulates folding inside the ribosomal exit tunnel.
authors: Wruck, Florian; Tian, Pengfei; Kudva, Renuka; Best, Robert B; von Heijne, Gunnar; Tans, Sander J; Katranidis, Alexandros
one_liner_zh: 该文研究核糖体出口通道内小蛋白结构域折叠，虽涉及分子动力学模拟，但核心是蛋白质-核糖体互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制关联较弱。
abstract: Proteins commonly fold co-translationally at the ribosome, while the nascent chain emerges from the ribosomal exit tunnel. Protein domains that are sufficiently small can even fold while still located inside the tunnel. However, the effect of the tunnel on the folding dynamics of these domains is not well understood. Here, we combine optical tweezers with single-molecule FRET and molecular dynamics simulations to investigate folding of the small zinc-finger domain ADR1a inside and at the vestibule of the ribosomal tunnel. The tunnel is found to accelerate folding and stabilize the folded state, reminiscent of the effects of chaperonins. However, a simple mechanism involving stabilization by confinement does not explain the results. Instead, it appears that electrostatic interactions between the protein and ribosome contribute to the observed folding acceleration and stabilization of ADR1a.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质通常在核糖体上共翻译折叠，同时新生链从核糖体出口通道中伸出。足够小的蛋白质结构域甚至可以在仍位于通道内时折叠。然而，通道对这些结构域折叠动力学的影响尚不明确。在此，我们结合光镊、单分子FRET和分子动力学模拟，研究小锌指结构域ADR1a在核糖体通道内部及其前庭处的折叠。研究发现，通道加速折叠并稳定折叠态，这让人联想到伴侣蛋白的作用。然而，仅通过限制效应实现稳定的简单机制并不能解释这些结果。相反，蛋白质与核糖体之间的静电相互作用似乎对观察到的ADR1a折叠加速和稳定化有所贡献。
